parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the Skill. Only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens are supported. The value can be up to 64 characters in length

parameters.name: name

parameters.example: A Skill for reviewing code quality, security risks, and coding standards.

parameters.example: {"skillMd":"# Code Review\n检查代码质量、安全风险和编码规范。"}
parameters.help_en: The Skill metadata in JSON object format. Exactly one content source must be provided. For more information about the fields, see "Request parameter description"
parameters.help_zh: Skill 元数据，格式为 JSON 对象。必须且只能提供一种内容来源，具体字段参见“请求参数补充说明”

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the Skill. Valid values:

user
tenant

Default value: user
parameters.help_zh: Skill 可见性。可选值为 `user` 和 `tenant`，默认值为 `user`
parameters.name: visibility
